subject.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.*.sandbox.skipSkillsSync` as the supported opt-in contract for preinstalled sandbox skills, or should this stay on the linked issue for a backend-capability design instead?
rationale: The patch adds a durable operator-facing config option and changes the sandbox skill-read invariant for users who enable it; code review can identify defects, but it cannot choose the product contract.

options.title: Approve after lifecycle repair
options.body: Accept the opt-in config direction after the reused-container setupCommand issue is fixed and covered by regression proof.

options.title: Move to backend capability design
options.body: Pause or close this PR and keep the linked issue as the design tracker if backends should declare preinstalled skill support instead of adding a user config flag.

options.title: Decline the core surface
options.body: Close or rework the PR if maintainers want core sandbox skill materialization to remain mandatory and custom deployments to use backend packaging only.

recommendation.title: Approve after lifecycle repair
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in config direction after the reused-container setupCommand issue is fixed and covered by regression proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the materialized sandbox skill behavior and startup prompt invariant changed by this option.
